label: Bias temperature instability
subgoals: Identify static gate bias and temperature as the BTI stress
Assign NBTI to PMOS and PBTI to NMOS with high-k stacks
Account for partial recovery when stress is removed

label: Power-law time dependence
subgoals: Form the ratio of target time to measured time
Raise it to the power-law exponent
Multiply the measured shift by that factor

label: Hot-carrier injection
subgoals: Require simultaneous current and high lateral field near the drain
Accumulate damage per switching event weighted by activity
Contrast the temperature dependence of HCI with BTI
